title: От Луки 22 — Luke 22
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: И тотчас, когда он ещё говорил, пропел ___.
cases.translation: And immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.
cases.explain: Петух is the subject of пропел (crowed), so it takes the nominative — the dictionary form.

cases.sentence: Когда я посылал вас без ___, без сумки, без сандалий, нуждались ли вы в чём-либо?
cases.translation: When I sent you without a purse, without a bag, without sandals, did you lack anything?
cases.explain: The preposition без (without) always governs the genitive case, so кошелёк becomes кошелька.

cases.sentence: Говорю вам, что должно исполниться сказанное в Писании: он был причислен к ___.
cases.translation: I tell you, that which is written must be fulfilled in me: he was counted among the criminals.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to/among) governs the dative case; причислен к преступникам means 'counted among the criminals'.

cases.sentence: Тогда сатана вошёл в ___, которого называли Искариотом, одного из числа двенадцати.
cases.translation: Then Satan entered into Judas, who was called Iscariot, one of the twelve.
cases.explain: The preposition в (into) with a verb of motion takes the accusative — сатана вошёл в Иуду, 'Satan entered into Judas'.

cases.sentence: Ведь кто важнее, тот, кто возлежит за ___, или тот, кто прислуживает?
cases.translation: For who is greater, the one who reclines at the table, or the one who serves?
cases.explain: The preposition за (at, indicating location) governs the instrumental case — возлежать за столом, 'to recline at the table'.

cases.sentence: Я каждый день был с вами в ___.
cases.translation: I was with you every day in the temple.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in), when marking location rather than motion, takes the prepositional case — в храме, 'in the temple'.

cases.translation: In the middle of the high priest's courtyard they kindled a fire.
cases.explain: The preposition посреди (in the middle of) governs the genitive case — посреди двора, 'in the middle of the courtyard'.

cases.sentence: Когда он поднялся с молитвы, он вернулся к ___.
cases.translation: When he rose from prayer, he returned to the disciples.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward, to) governs the dative case — вернулся к ученикам, 'returned to the disciples'.

reading.ru: Приближался праздник пресных хлебов, называемый Пасхой. Первосвященники и учители закона искали способа разделаться с Иисусом так, чтобы не вызвать возмущение народа.
reading.question: Why did the chief priests and scribes want a quiet way to kill Jesus?
options: They were afraid it would provoke the people
They wanted to wait until after Passover
They needed the Romans to arrest him instead
reading.correct: They were afraid it would provoke the people
reading.explain: They sought a way to kill him without causing an uproar among the people, as the feast of Passover was approaching.

reading.ru: Тогда сатана вошел в Иуду, которого называли Искариотом, одного из числа двенадцати. Иуда пошел и сговорился с первосвященниками и с начальниками храмовой стражи, как предать им Иисуса. Те обрадовались и обещали заплатить ему.
reading.question: What happened after Satan entered Judas and he approached the chief priests?
options: They were glad and agreed to pay him
They refused to meet with him
They sent him away without an answer
reading.correct: They were glad and agreed to pay him
reading.explain: Judas arranged with the chief priests how to betray Jesus, and they were glad and promised to pay him.

reading.ru: Когда вы войдете в город, то встретите человека, несущего кувшин с водой. Идите за ним в дом, куда он войдет.
reading.question: How would Peter and John recognize the man to follow to the upper room?
options: He would be carrying a jar of water
He would be riding a donkey
He would be wearing a red cloak
He would call out their names
reading.correct: He would be carrying a jar of water
reading.explain: Jesus told them they would meet a man carrying a jar of water and should follow him into the house he entered.

reading.ru: Я очень хотел есть эту Пасху с вами перед моими страданиями.
reading.question: What did Jesus say about eating this Passover with his disciples?
options: He earnestly desired to eat it with them before his suffering
He said he was too troubled to eat
He asked the disciples to eat without him
He said he would rather fast that day
reading.correct: He earnestly desired to eat it with them before his suffering
reading.explain: Jesus told them he had earnestly desired to eat this Passover with them before his suffering.

reading.ru: Это мое тело, отдаваемое за вас, делайте это воспоминание обо мне
reading.question: What did Jesus say the bread represented at the Last Supper?
options: The unleavened bread of Passover only
reading.explain: Jesus broke the bread and said, 'This is my body given for you; do this in remembrance of me.'

reading.ru: Эта чаша — новый завет, скрепленный моей кровью, которая за вас проливается
reading.question: What did Jesus say the cup represented?
options: The new covenant in his blood
reading.correct: The new covenant in his blood
reading.explain: Jesus said the cup was the new covenant, sealed by his blood, which was being poured out for them.

reading.ru: Я же среди вас, как слуга.
reading.question: How did Jesus describe his own role during the dispute over who was greatest?
reading.explain: In response to the disciples' dispute about greatness, Jesus said he was among them as one who serves.

reading.ru: Говорю тебе, Петр, не успеет и петух пропеть сегодня, как ты трижды отречешься от того, что знаешь Меня
reading.question: What did Jesus predict about Peter?
options: Peter would deny knowing him three times before the rooster crowed
Peter would betray him for money
Peter would fall asleep during prayer
reading.correct: Peter would deny knowing him three times before the rooster crowed
reading.explain: Jesus told Peter that before the rooster crowed that day, Peter would deny knowing him three times.

reading.ru: Говорю вам, что со мной должно исполниться сказанное в Писании, он был причислен к преступникам.
reading.question: What scripture did Jesus say must be fulfilled in him?
options: That he would be counted among criminals
That he would rule over Israel
That he would be crowned king
That he would flee to Egypt
reading.correct: That he would be counted among criminals
reading.explain: Jesus said it was written that he would be counted among the criminals, and this must be fulfilled.

reading.ru: Отец, если ты хочешь, пронеси эту чашу мимо меня, но пусть все будет не по моей воле, а по твоей
reading.question: What did Jesus pray on the Mount of Olives?
options: That God's will be done, not his own
That the disciples would be forgiven
That the Romans would leave Jerusalem
reading.correct: That God's will be done, not his own
reading.explain: Jesus prayed that the cup be taken from him, yet asked for God's will, not his own, to be done.

reading.ru: Когда он поднялся с молитвы и вернулся к ученикам, то нашел их спящими, потому что они были измучены печалью.
reading.question: What did Jesus find when he returned to his disciples after praying?
options: They were asleep, exhausted from sorrow
They were praying together with him
reading.correct: They were asleep, exhausted from sorrow
reading.explain: When Jesus rose from prayer and returned to the disciples, he found them sleeping because of grief.

reading.ru: Иуда, ты поцелуем предаешь сына человеческого?
reading.question: How did Judas identify Jesus to the arresting crowd?
reading.explain: When Judas approached to kiss him, Jesus asked, 'Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?'

reading.ru: Он прикоснулся к уху слуги и исцелил его.
reading.question: What did Jesus do after a disciple cut off the high priest's servant's ear?
options: He touched the ear and healed it
He rebuked the disciples and left
He asked the crowd to help the servant
reading.correct: He touched the ear and healed it
reading.explain: After the servant's ear was cut off, Jesus touched his ear and healed him.

reading.ru: И тотчас, когда он еще говорил, пропел петух. Господь повернулся и посмотрел на Петра.
reading.question: What happened immediately after Peter denied Jesus a third time?
options: A rooster crowed and the Lord looked at Peter
Peter ran to warn the other disciples
The high priest questioned Peter directly
reading.correct: A rooster crowed and the Lord looked at Peter
reading.explain: As soon as Peter finished his third denial, a rooster crowed, and the Lord turned and looked at him.

reading.ru: Они все стали спрашивать. «Так ты что, сын Бога?» Он ответил. «Вы сами говорите, что это я».
reading.question: How did Jesus respond when the council asked if he was the Son of God?
options: He asked them to decide later
reading.explain: When the council asked if he was the Son of God, Jesus answered, 'You say that I am.'
